chapter.name: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi

hadith.translation: The report is not like witnessing
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 1 · Book 1, Hadith 1

hadith.translation: War is deception
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 2 · Book 1, Hadith 2

hadith.translation: A Muslim is a mirror of the Muslim
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 3 · Book 1, Hadith 3

hadith.translation: Someone whose advice is sought is in a position of trust
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 4 · Book 1, Hadith 4

hadith.translation: The person guiding (someone) to do a good deed, is like the one performing the good deed
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 5 · Book 1, Hadith 5

hadith.translation: Seek help for any needs discreetly
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 6 · Book 1, Hadith 6

hadith.translation: Protect yourself from the fire even with a part of a date
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 7 · Book 1, Hadith 7

hadith.arabic: الدُّنْیَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤمِنِ وَ جَنَّةُ الْکَافِرِ
hadith.translation: The world is the believer’s prison and the disbeliever’s paradise
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 8 · Book 1, Hadith 8

hadith.translation: Modesty is entirely good
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 9 · Book 1, Hadith 9

hadith.translation: The word of the believer is like seizing of the hand
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 10 · Book 1, Hadith 10

hadith.arabic: لَا یَحِلُّ لِمُؤمِنٍ اَنْ یَّجُهْرَ أخَاهُ فَوقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أیَّامٍ
hadith.translation: It is unlawful for a believer to sever relations with his brother for more than three days
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 11 · Book 1, Hadith 11

hadith.translation: He is not one of us who cheats us
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 12 · Book 1, Hadith 12

hadith.arabic: مَا قَلَّ وَكَفَى خَيْرٌ مِمَّا كَثُرَ وَأَلْهَى
hadith.translation: A little that suffices is better than an abundance that distracts
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 13 · Book 1, Hadith 13

hadith.arabic: الرَّاجِعُ فِيْ هِبَتِهِ کَالرَّاجِعِ فِيْ قَیْئِهِ
hadith.translation: Someone who takes back his gift is like someone who eats his vomit
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 14 · Book 1, Hadith 14

hadith.translation: Affliction comes from (loose) talk
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 15 · Book 1, Hadith 15

hadith.translation: People are like the teeth of a comb
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 16 · Book 1, Hadith 16

hadith.translation: Richness lies in the richness of the soul
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 17 · Book 1, Hadith 17

hadith.translation: The felicitous person takes lessons from (the actions of) others
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 18 · Book 1, Hadith 18

hadith.arabic: وَ إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ لَحِکْمَةً وَاِنَّ مِنَ الْبَیَانِ لَسِحْرًا
hadith.translation: Indeed, in poetry there is wisdom and in eloquence there is magic
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 19 · Book 1, Hadith 19

hadith.translation: The king’s pardon preserves the kingdom
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 20 · Book 1, Hadith 20

hadith.translation: A man will be with whom he loves
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 21 · Book 1, Hadith 21

hadith.translation: A man who knows his worth will not be ruined
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 22 · Book 1, Hadith 22

hadith.translation: The child belongs to the bed and stoning is for the adulterer
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 23 · Book 1, Hadith 23

hadith.arabic: الْیَدُ الْعُلْیَا خَیْرٌ مِّنَ الْیَدِ السُّفْلَی
hadith.translation: The upper hand is superior to the lower hand
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 24 · Book 1, Hadith 24

hadith.arabic: لَا شَکَرَ اللهَ مَنْ لَّا یَشْکُرُ النَّاسَ
hadith.translation: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 25 · Book 1, Hadith 25

hadith.translation: Your love of something can blind and deafen (you)
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 26 · Book 1, Hadith 26

hadith.arabic: جُبِلَتِ الْقُلُوبُ عَلی حُبَّ مَنْ اَحْسَنَ اِلَیْهَا وَ بُغْضِ مَنْ اَسَاءَ اِلَیْهَا
hadith.translation: Hearts are predisposed to love someone who does them good and detest someone who does them harm
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 27 · Book 1, Hadith 27

hadith.arabic: الْتَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ کَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ
hadith.translation: One who repents from sin is like someone without sin
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 28 · Book 1, Hadith 28

hadith.arabic: الشَّاهِدُ یَرَی مَا لَا یَرَاهُ الْغَائِبُ
hadith.translation: The person who actually witnesses an (event) sees that which one who is absent does not
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 29 · Book 1, Hadith 29

hadith.translation: If the nobleman of a people comes to you, honour him
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 30 · Book 1, Hadith 30

hadith.translation: False oaths lay waste to home (lands)
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 31 · Book 1, Hadith 31

hadith.arabic: مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِیْدٌ
hadith.translation: Whoever is killed attempting to save his property is a martyr
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 32 · Book 1, Hadith 32

hadith.translation: Actions are through intentions
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 33 · Book 1, Hadith 33

hadith.translation: The leader of a people is their servant
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 34 · Book 1, Hadith 34

hadith.translation: The best of affairs is that which is balanced
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 35 · Book 1, Hadith 35

hadith.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِیْ أُمَّتِیْ فِی بُکُوْرِهَا یَوْمَ الْخَمِیْسِ
hadith.translation: O Allah, bless my nation in its early rising on Thursdays
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 36 · Book 1, Hadith 36

hadith.translation: Poverty can almost turn into disbelief
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 37 · Book 1, Hadith 37

hadith.translation: Travelling is a portion of punishment
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 38 · Book 1, Hadith 38

hadith.translation: The best of provision is God-Consciousness (taqwa)
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 39 · Book 1, Hadith 39

hadith.translation: Meetings are under trust
hadith.reference: Shah Waliullah's Forty Hadith 40 · Book 1, Hadith 40
